en.title: Shortest Time to Visit Servers on a Ring Sequentially
en.description:
Servers 1..total form a ring with unit-length edges. Choose any starting server and visit all target servers along one continuous sequential route; crossing each edge takes 1 unit of time, and this is not a simultaneous broadcast in both directions. Targets are distinct.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n total; the second line contains n target IDs. 1≤total≤10^9, 1≤n≤min(total,100000), 1≤ID≤total. The original constraint ID≤n conflicts with the statement and all examples, so it is restored to ≤total according to the statement.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 4, 1 and 0. With a single target, simply start there.
hints: Sort the targets and compute the gaps between adjacent targets, including the wrap-around gap between the last and the first; the answer is the ring length minus the largest gap.
